name: KARAN SINGH
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: An aggressive all-court player with a powerful serve and strong baseline game, adept on clay and hard courts.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ATP Challenger Titles: Won 1 Challenger doubles title at the 2024 Brazzaville Challenger with Florent Bax. ITF Success: Secured 1 ITF Futures singles title (2023 M15 Monastir) and 2 doubles titles. Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 248 Nick Chappell at the 2024 ITF M15 Ahmedabad. Davis Cup & National Representation: Debuted in Davis Cup on February 2, 2025, defeating Togo’s Hod’abalo Isak Padio (6-2, 6-3), becoming the 51st Indian to win a singles rubber.
Other Highlights: Won the 2021 Fenesta U18 National Championship and the 2024 National Games gold medal in Gujarat. Trained at the National Tennis Centre in Delhi under Zeeshan Ali and now with Aditya Sachdeva. Qualified for the 2025 Bengaluru Open main draw.
Karan is an emerging talent in Indian tennis, aiming to break into the ATP Top 200. 🎾🇮🇳
